decisions.reason: The online customer portal is a low-cost digital option that fits the firm's move toward deeper brand collaboration, and its value is still uncertain and unresolved, so keeping it is worth more than dropping it.
The packaging display won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, a positive early signal that its value is being realized, so the option justifies further commitment.

The quarter-pallet pegboard display sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep on its own page, though it is one of several similar display options, so the risk of its being pruned is moderate.
The small counter display is a cheap, core-adjacent option whose market value is not yet resolved, so keeping it is justified despite many similar alternatives in the portfolio.

The freestanding information display has low carrying cost and still-uncertain prospects, so the option remains worth holding, with some risk that it is consolidated among the many similar standard displays.
